title: Construction and movement

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Connect infrastructure to daily movement so city development is represented as part of lived experience.
strategic_value: Buildings, a cyclist, rail transport and water can link Helsinki’s growing city to familiar routines.
demonstration: A cyclist, crane and tall buildings occupy the left and center; a white bridge sits above blue water at right, with an orange train and smaller structures below.
practical_value: Choose infrastructure and movement motifs that fit the subject instead of treating architecture as a generic backdrop.
